items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: I would like to thank Harry Susha, the president of the New Orleans Jazz Club, and Dick Allen for the wonderful tribute they paid to me a few days ago.

ctx.x: This is Edmund Hall. I would like to thank Harry Susha, the president of the New Orleans Jazz Club, and Dick Allen for the wonderful tribute they paid to me a few days ago. And I want to thank also all the jazz fans. I think we got the thing going.
Anybody can start talking all the time you're out there.
